scripts.build: pnpm --filter @litetrack/contracts build && pnpm --filter server db:generate && pnpm --filter server build && pnpm --filter @boses/litetrack-sdk build && node apps/sdk/scripts/publish.mjs --preview && pnpm --filter admin build
scripts.dev: pnpm --filter @litetrack/contracts build && pnpm --filter server db:generate && pnpm --filter @boses/litetrack-sdk build && node apps/sdk/scripts/publish.mjs --preview && pnpm --parallel --filter admin --filter server dev
scripts.type-check: pnpm --filter @litetrack/contracts build && pnpm -r --if-present type-check && pnpm --filter server check
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @litetrack/contracts build && pnpm --filter server test && pnpm --filter @boses/litetrack-sdk test
